records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended July 2, 2022, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change in twelve-month backlog at July 2, 2022 as compared with the twelve-month backlog at July 3, 2021 was driven by increases in all segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Twelve-month backlog increased in Industrial Systems due to strong demand for our core industrial products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the third quarter of 2022 compared to the third quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity and our cash flow from operations have provided us with the financial resources needed to make organic investments, fund acquisitive growth and return capital to shareholders.
